assign.request: UX rethink pass on /imagine/cms/ - five sentences, try an alternative landing layout for real and measure it, make it more visual, verify persistence, fix the load_all_children guard bug, prove the primary interaction, land.
steps: build + measure an alternative landing layout

log.msg: fixed public/imagine/cms/json/page.js -- load_all_children() was missing core's levels<=this.loaded guard (the exact bug named in the brief), copied the four-line guard from paging/make/page.js verbatim.

BEFORE five sentences (/imagine/cms/): what=a demo CMS -- open welcome.md in a form, edit it, save, the file on disk changes. use=click one of five cards (Thinking/Welcome/Edit/Services/JSON pages); Edit is the one that writes anything. goal=leave believing no backend was needed -- a markdown file plus the dev socket already is a CMS. hard=2/5 -- the wall names five things clearly but Welcome's card was a bare title (no description, no icon) and every other card was a generic Material icon, so nothing showed what any of the five actually look like. better=swap the five icons for real stills of the five pages, since none of them look alike.

landing page is a wall of 5 children (menu-of-choices shape) -- per the first nine reviewers' finding, the 3-column card is already disproved for this shape (1.5-5x height for zero width gain, 5 realms), so it was not rebuilt here; the previews() tile wall this page already used is the approved-five's own answer for 'a region of same-shaped children'.

ALTERNATIVE TRIED (real build+measure): the landing page splits its closing guidance into a second column (classes:'default', title Guide) beside the wall, specifically to eat the dead band past the wall -- a fix from the 2026-09-04 critique. Tested undoing it: merged Guide's prose back into the main column as trailing md() after the wall, one column instead of two. Measured at 3440: width used 2412/3440=70.1% -> 1584/3440=46.0% (worse, -24pts, dead space 1028px -> 1856px, exactly the site-wide known band); my column's own content height 794px -> 1002px (+26%, the merged prose now stacks under the wall instead of running parallel beside it). At 1280 the two variants were within 11px of each other (no ancestor-column subsidy there). REVERTED -- the 2-column split earns its keep specifically at wide viewports, which is the case this whole pass cares about; the prior critique's fix stands, confirmed with real numbers instead of taken on faith.

VISUAL: replaced the landing wall's five generic Material icons (thinking=school, welcome=none, edit=edit_note, services=cloud, json=storage) with five real screenshots (public/imagine/cms/shots/*.jpg, captured headless from the live pages) via a hand-drawn preview_card(nav, thumb) wall in place of previews(). Welcome's card in particular went from a bare title with nothing under it to an actual picture of the rendered page. --stage set to 16/6.5 (default is 16/10) to keep the height cost down, since this wall's column is only 2 tracks wide at 1280 (not 4+ like a full-width realm) -- cost measured at +74px (1280, 750.8->823.8) and +25px (3440, 769.7->794.4), both under 10%.

PERSISTENCE: grep found store()/localStorage only in cms/edit/page.js (an in-progress draft of welcome.md, cleared on Save or Discard -- a real MODIFIED case, not a kept-on-purpose one). Swapped its bespoke 'draft . restored' span + one-click Discard button for the shared /imagine/paging/baseline.js mark: amber 'Modified' text + two-press Reset, wired restore() to this page's own discard() so the two-press protection is real (no more one-click data loss) while keeping the documented no-reload behavior. cms/json/page.js and cms/json/edit/page.js write straight to page.json/page.jsonl on disk (rpc:append/rpc:write) -- that is content, not a demo state, so baseline() does not apply there; confirmed none of the other 3 realm pages (thinking, welcome, services) touch localStorage at all.

UI-TEST (headless, public/imagine/cms/edit/): cleared localStorage, confirmed no mark at baseline. Typed a marker -> amber 'Modified' mark + Reset appeared after the 400ms debounce. Clicked Save -> status said saved, welcome.md on disk gained the marker (verified by reading the file), mark cleared. Typed a second, unsaved change -> mark reappeared. Pressed Reset (armed) then 'Press again to forget...' (confirmed) -> textarea reverted to the last-saved text in place with no reload, mark gone. Restored welcome.md to its original bytes and cleared localStorage; git diff on welcome.md is empty. Also proved the json/page.js fix: a cold load of /imagine/cms/json/format/snapshot/shape/ (three levels of data-only pages) rendered 'The node' with no 'Chaining cycle detected' error.

CONSOLE: exactly one error per page load across cms/, cms/thinking/, cms/welcome/, cms/services/, cms/json/, cms/edit/ at both 1280 and 3440 -- the pre-existing, documented 404 for /imagine/cms/welcome/page.js (Page.file()'s own markdown-has-no-page.js case, named in edit/doc/decisions.md before this task started). No new errors anywhere.

AFTER five sentences (/imagine/cms/): what=a demo CMS -- open welcome.md in a form, edit it, save, the file on disk changes. use=click one of five cards, now shown as real screenshots of the five pages instead of icons; Edit's thumb (a split source/preview pane) makes it obvious which one writes. goal=leave believing no backend was needed -- a markdown file plus the dev socket already is a CMS. hard=1/5 -- every card now shows what it actually looks like, so the five choices read as five different things at a glance instead of five identical icon tiles. better=a sixth still, of the CMS's own landing page, so a reader arriving from outside sees the whole five-card wall before clicking into it (this page cannot preview itself).

documentation pass: cms/readme.md (2026-09-05 section: stills, reverted alt, baseline swap, json fix), cms/edit/readme.md + doc/decisions.md (baseline() swap + re-verification), cms/json/readme.md (load_all_children guard, watch-out bullet). No skill misled me -- no skill-improvement entry needed.

css skill caught a smell: the thumb sizing (width/height/object-fit/object-position) was written as inline .style(...) on the , and design/design.css's .design-shot already set the precedent (a small stylesheet, one class, loaded via View.stylesheet). Moved it to public/imagine/cms/cms.css's new .cms-shot class. Registering the cms- prefix in framework/styles/css-scopes.txt is OUT OF MY FENCE tonight (I wrote it once, caught it, reverted it immediately -- git diff on that file is clean) -- PROPOSED line for whoever owns it: `cms- /imagine/cms (the landing page's own card wall -- cms-shot)` beside `codrops-` in the `# imagine` block. Re-measured after the refactor: identical numbers (823.8/794.4px), confirming it was a code-quality change with no visual effect.

assign.outcome: **Landing wall's five icons are now five real screenshots, kept; the 2-column split (`Guide` beside the wall) was tried as a 1-column merge and reverted with real numbers; `edit/`'s draft note now uses the site's shared `baseline()` mark; `json/page.js`'s missing `load_all_children` guard is fixed.** Cards: swapped generic Material icons (and `Welcome`'s bare title) for real stills of the five child pages (`preview_card()` + a hand-drawn wall, `--stage: 16/6.5` to keep the height cost small — +74px/1280, +25px/3440). Layout: tried folding the `Guide` column back into one column — 3440 width used fell 70.1% -> 46.0% (the exact ~1856px site-wide dead band came back) and the column got 26% taller — reverted, the 2026-09-04 split earns its keep. Persistence: `edit/`'s bespoke draft note + one-click Discard replaced by `/imagine/paging/baseline.js`'s amber mark + two-press Reset (wired to the existing `discard()`, so it still restores in place with no reload) — proved headless end to end, including the file round-trip on disk and a clean `git diff` after. Fixed the brief's named bug: `json/page.js` was missing core's `levels <= this.loaded` guard, so a cold deep url like `/imagine/cms/json/format/snapshot/shape/` threw "Chaining cycle detected for promise" — copied the four-line guard from `paging/make/page.js`; verified the same url now loads clean. Zero new console errors at 1280/3440 across all six pages touched. Proposed: register `cms-` in `framework/styles/css-scopes.txt` (outside this task's fence) — the exact line is in the log.
